item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00236","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C24","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 plausibly supplied a material template for the child's liquidation transfer provisions. Both directives transfer an agency's functions and associated records or property to a designated successor, then separately transfer as much available funding as the Director or Bureau of the Budget deems necessary. That combination, sequence, and closely parallel phrasing are more concrete than a generic agency reorganization. C24 has similarly strong transfer machinery involving functions, personnel, records, property, and funds, but its funding determination is joint and merely subject to Budget approval. C01 supplies only the simpler pattern of discontinuing offices and transferring their business and archives.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"there are hereby transferred to the Interstate Commerce Commission the remaining records, property, and personnel ... together with so much of the functions ... as is necessary","parent_excerpt":"All functions of administration ... together with (a) such supplies, equipment, temporary structures, utilities and facilities ... and (b) the cemetery records ... are hereby transferred to the American Battle Monuments Commission","explanation":"Both use an operative transfer to move functions and the related property and records to a successor agency."},{"child_excerpt":"so much of the funds thereof as the Bureau of the Budget shall determine","parent_excerpt":"so much of the unexpended balances of appropriations ... as the Director of the Bureau of the Budget may deem necessary","explanation":"Distinctively parallel fiscal machinery delegates determination of the necessary transferred funds to the Bureau of the Budget."},{"child_excerpt":"The Interstate Commerce Commission is hereby designated as the agency which shall complete the liquidation ... For the purpose of such liquidation there are hereby transferred","parent_excerpt":"are hereby transferred to the American Battle Monuments Commission; such transfer to become effective","explanation":"The provisions share the structural sequence of identifying the successor and transferring the operational package needed for the successor's assigned role."}]}
